dimension_semantics.A_table_vs_H_equation: C.4 calls height A; Eq3.7a uses H.2020Eq6 uses A. Kept A_mm_as_printed, interpreted as same height for reconstruction.
dimension_semantics.C: Table C=300mm initially; literal equation uses C as hole extrusion depth, which fails to reproduce published volume.
dimension_semantics.L: Table L=200mm initially; using L as hole extrusion depth reproduces volume after inferred pi rounding. This is a reconstruction hypothesis, not a silently changed source.
dimension_semantics.CF_LF: Per-hole-family cross-section lengths in mm. Orientation labels may rotate between hole families; product determines rectangular area. Measurement averaging across individual holes not established.
dimension_semantics.time: min;2.430 and3.870 interpreted2430/3870 based on two24h processing steps.

equations.pi_reference: Python math.pi, converted from its decimal representation; not arbitrary-precision pi. Extra saved digits are arithmetic provenance, not physical accuracy.
equations.author_rounding_hypothesis: pi=3.14 gives all33published volumes to nearest1mm3. This value is diagnostic only, not a physical parameter or implementation default.
equations.specific_area_as_printed: A0*=(1-epsilon)*a_p/V_p; dimensionL^-1 if a_p isarea andV_p isvolume; not an absolute area.

volume_interpretation.author_volume: Calculated from dimensions; not an independent measured3Dvolume.
volume_interpretation.net_volume: Outer envelope minus23macroscopic channels; still includes unresolved pores inside the clay matrix.
volume_interpretation.macroscopic_hole_fraction: V_channels/V_envelope, not matrix porosity or total accessible pore space.
volume_interpretation.VF_symbol_overload: Eq3.7 VF means holevolume; Table3.1 V_F means final productvolume.70C final matches990min, not2430or3870min.

measurement_point.diagram_description: T marker at upper-right exterior corner of the depicted perforated section, near the upper-right circular hole.
measurement_point.measurement: Infrared surface measurement after sample removal.
measurement_point.prohibited_interpretation: Not center temperature; do not assign a precise corner coordinate from an unscaled schematic.

geometry_limits: Hole counts and family sizes do not specify individual hole centers, wall thickness distribution or completeCAD.
Straight uniform channels and identical holes within a family are author geometric idealizations, not independently measured alongdepth.
Tabulated fluctuations preserved; no monotone smoothing or shrinkage law fitted.
Measured geometry imposed on a future model would be an input, not independent predicted shrinkage.
No area, boundary transfer coefficient or microscopic porosity inferred from macro voidfraction.
